text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh, jeez!! So frustrating, frustrating, 
frustrating!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, Tokai Teio came bursting into the 
trainer's office with a loud shout.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I lost to McQueen on the math test! By one 
point! Just one point! Ugh, so 
frustrating~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"I'm definitely gonna win on tomorrow's 
sports science test! Time for some intense 
training! Come on, let's go!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
The library, obviously! Come on, let's 
hurry!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Now then, the reference books should be 
around here— Wait, McQueen!?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: And the book in their hand is...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Are you asking about this book? I'm about 
to borrow it, is there any problem?"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Totally! Absolutely down! I mean—

text_block_list.name: Library Committee Member
text_block_list.text: Um. Please keep it down in the library...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I'm sorry. You're right, quiet, 
quiet...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Aside from that, I was the one trying to 
borrow it first, so I have the right to 
rent it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
All the books in the library belong to the 
academy, right? If you want to see it that 
badly, would you like to look together?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
That's... I mean, it just feels kinda off, 
you know...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...I don't really understand, but in that 
case, you wouldn't mind if I borrowed it, 
would you?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
No! I told you, that's not okay! I want 
McQueen toâ

text_block_list.name: Library Committee Member
text_block_list.text:
*Ahem!* Did I not just remind you to keep 
quiet in the library?

text_block_list.name: Library Committee Member
text_block_list.text:
You're disturbing the other visitors, so 
both of you are banned from the library 
for the rest of the day!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: No way!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Me as well?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
For an Umamusume of the Mejiro family to 
be locked out of the library...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ah, this is a shame that will last for 
generations...
choice_data_list: I got a bit too stubborn.
We got a bit too stubborn, huh?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Uuuugh... Uuuuugh~...!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...I can't help it. When it's you, I 
just...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
No matter what, I just can't bring myself 
to lose to you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Teio-san...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Honestly... you really are hopeless.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Uuugh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...Come now, how long do you intend to 
mope around? Or would you rather end our 
match here?"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...! No no no, I won't, I won't!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Still, what should I do about studying? I 
at least need somewhere I can focus...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Wait, that's it! Hey, hey, lend me the 
Trainer's office, will ya?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"That's the spirit! That's my Trainer♪ 
Come on, McQueen, let's go~!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Wait, me as well?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the two of them happily studied 
together... or not.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! You're still taking so long to solve 
the problems? I've already solved three of 
them, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Geez! You're distracting me! This isn't a 
race, so speed doesn't matter here, does 
it!?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, there's no way I can study 
properly. In that case...

Let's test each other with questions and 
compete!

If you want to see who's better that 
badly, go out and race.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Oh, sounds great! Let's get right to it!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"What do you call the force that a leg 
exerts on the ground when running?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Since we're talking about force... 'Ground 
Reaction Force'! Fufun, something of this 
level is a piece of cake for me!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Grrr... Correct.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Well then, it's my turn next. Regarding 
the relationship between ground reaction 
force and foot strike—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The two engaged in a back-and-forth 
battle. I later heard that both scored 100 
points on the test, ending the contest in 
a draw.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: "That's it! Test prep is on hold for now!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, rather than continuing endless, 
fruitless disputes, it is better to settle 
this once and for all!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Alright, Trainer! I'm heading out!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I heard later that while neither of their 
test scores was great, their times on the 
track had improved.
